title: Clinical Research Manager
description:
Category: Pharma/Biotech/Clinical Research

Location:

The Clinical Research Manager (CRM) is responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of clinical trials conducted across various phases. This role ensures that studies are executed in compliance with regulatory requirements, GCP/ICH guidelines, and internal SOPs. The CRM manages cross-functional teams, monitors timelines and budgets, and acts as the primary liaison between investigators, CROs, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the planning, execution, and management of clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas and phases.
Oversee site selection, study start-up, patient recruitment, data collection, and close-out activities.
Ensure compliance with FDA, ICH-GCP, and other applicable regulatory standards.
Develop and maintain project timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
Supervise and mentor Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), Clinical Trial Assistants (CTAs), and study coordinators.
Review and approve study documentation including protocols, CRFs, informed consent forms, and monitoring reports.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including regulatory affairs, data management, biostatistics, and medical writing.
Manage vendor and CRO relationships, including contract negotiations and performance monitoring.
Track and report on study metrics and provide regular updates to senior leadership.
Oversee the preparation and conduct of audits and regulatory inspections.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or related field (Master’s or Ph.D. preferred).
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in clinical research, including 2+ years in a managerial or supervisory role.
In-depth knowledge of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing Phase I-IV trials across multiple therapeutic areas.
Strong project management, leadership, and team coordination skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Proficiency with clinical trial software (e.g., CTMS, EDC, eTMF platforms).
Ability to travel up to 20% as needed.

In addition to a dynamic and collaborative work environment, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well-being. Our benefits include paid holidays, Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, and medical insurance to ensure our team members have the flexibility and coverage they need. We believe in fostering a healthy work-life balance while providing the necessary support for professional and personal growth.

Be part of our network of Subject Matter Experts.​

Job Location Type: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Annual CEU allowance

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

Legora is scaling quickly, and we're building a finance function to match. We're looking for a senior Revenue Accounting leader to own revenue recognition and sales commissions accounting end to end, and to build out the team. You'll take a function that has grown fast and make it scalable, well-controlled, and audit-ready.

- Lead Revenue Accounting globally, ensuring related accounting, controls, and reporting are executed accurately and on time across all entities

- Shape revenue and commissions processes in our new ERP and its integration with Salesforce and our billing tools

- Strengthen the internal control environment, including SOX readiness and execution, process documentation and control design

WHAT YOU BRING

- 10+ years of accounting experience, starting in Big 4 audit or technical accounting

- Track record of building or scaling a revenue accounting function in a high-growth environment

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Coalitions Intern - Pacific Legal Foundation
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

General Information
The Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, PLF battles for freedom in the nation’s capitols, courts, and the court of public opinion.
 
As a national nonprofit law firm, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. Interns work remotely by default, but they can request to work physically in any of PLF’s offices. Interns are expected to work part time (24 hours per week).
 
You: An inquisitive, creative, and self-motivated college junior, senior, grad student, or recent graduate who knows the principles of liberty and seeks to advance them. You have strong written and oral communication skills and enjoy problem solving.
 
Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources.
 
Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the U.S. Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. Since 2024, PLF’s state-policy team has capitalized on our Supreme Court wins and helped pass 96 bills across 41 states by testifying, refining bill language, and guiding local allies toward victory. At PLF, we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.
 
As a member of the State Policy team, you will work with all PLF’s capabilities-litigation, strategic research, coalitions, and communications-to draft legislation, model bills, one-pagers, research memos, and blogs and op-eds supporting our mission and vision.
 
Your specific job duties will likely include:
Conducting legislative and other research to support policy drafting
Drafting one-pagers, op-eds, blogposts, and other supporting documentation for PLF’s model policies
Reviewing legislation and providing support to the State Policy team
 
This role is ideal for someone with:
Curiosity about the law and public policy
Knowledge of and a principled passion for individual liberty, one that transcends private or other political interests
Strong writing and research skills
 
How to Apply
If you think you might be a good fit, submit in ONE PDF:
A résumé that includes relevant experience in the liberty movement and professional skills.
A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants.
 
Applicants selected for an interview may be asked to provide:
A writing sample.
A semester schedule (if taking classes during the internship period).

• Drive engineering practices that treat authentication as a production service: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and frequent, low-risk releases.

• Partner with security architecture, infrastructure, application, and compliance teams to translate authentication standards (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML) into secure, reusable solutions.

• Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and how to build secure, resilient services on it.

• Software development experience: while you won't be writing code, you should have prior experience and be able to read and review it.

• Experience leading engineers or leading technical teams, with the ability to coach, set priorities, and deliver results through others.

• Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols and security fundamentals.

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Track record of running large-scale transformations, including stakeholder alignment, phased rollout, and change management.

Nice to Have

• Experience with PingFederate, including migrating from or running it alongside Entra.

• Familiarity with workload identity and non-human identity (NHI) authentication.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Risk
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

SENIOR DATA ANALYST - ENTERPRISE RISK

THE ROLE

Teya is building its Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and strengthening how risk information is brought together, analysed and reported across the business.

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in turning risk data into reliable measures, meaningful insights and actionable reporting. You'll work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and stakeholders across Credit, Fraud, AML, People, IT, Operations and Finance to understand the risks facing the business, identify the right data to monitor them, and develop effective reporting and early-warning capabilities.

This is a business-facing analytical role. Understanding risk, working effectively with risk owners and translating their requirements into practical data solutions will be just as important as your technical skills. You'll help ensure key risk indicators (KRIs) are meaningful, data is reliable, thresholds are appropriately informed by analysis, and reporting supports better risk oversight and decision-making.

You'll also help modernise how risk reporting is produced, using AI models and workflow automation to bring together internal data and relevant external information, identify emerging issues and reduce manual effort. The focus is on practical application, with robust validation, traceability and human oversight.

This is an opportunity to combine risk expertise, analytical problem-solving and emerging AI capabilities to help shape how a growing fintech business identifies, monitors and manages risk.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Develop risk data and reporting: Identify and map relevant data sources, using tools such as Snowflake to build repeatable datasets for KRIs across operational, credit, fraud, AML, people, capital, liquidity and other risk categories.

- Partner with risk stakeholders: Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and risk owners across the business to understand their priorities, clarify reporting requirements and translate risk management needs into practical analytical solutions.

- Analyse and monitor risk indicators: Use SQL and Python to investigate trends, test assumptions, identify anomalies and understand changes in risk exposure. Help risk owners interpret findings and determine where further investigation or action may be needed.

- Support KRI definitions and thresholds: Work with risk stakeholders to validate indicator definitions, assess data quality and analyse historical and current performance to inform threshold calibration. Help ensure indicators provide meaningful insight into the risks they are intended to monitor.

- Build dashboards and management reporting: Develop clear, accessible dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools, supporting monthly ERMF reporting and management oversight.

- Automate risk reporting with AI: Build and improve AI-enabled workflows that bring together internal data and relevant external signals, including regulatory updates,

Stipendiets syfte är att premiera och stimulera idérika personer att vidareutveckla sina idéer. Knowit vill främja ett innovativt tänkande för att möjliggöra utvecklandet av något originellt och principiellt nytt av betydelse inom en verksamhet eller ett område.
Stipendiet utgör en belöning för en god studieprestation där särskild hänsyn ska tas till ett innovativt examensarbete - inom vilket ämnesområde som helst. Stipendiet kan delas mellan flera examensarbeten. Om flera studeranden gemensamt utfört ett examensarbete, kan dock stipendiet delas mellan dem.
Stipendieansökan värderas i två steg. I första steget sker en granskning utifrån de akademiska meriterna. I andra steget sker en granskning utifrån de innovativa kvaliteterna. Denna granskning görs av donatorer och beaktar fyra olika dimensioner:

• Innovativ höjd - grad av nyhetsvärde

• Strategisk höjd - grad av framåtriktning

• Realistisk höjd - grad av genomförbarhet

• Värdeskapande höjd - grad av ekonomiskt, kulturellt, socialt, kvalitativt värde

Dessa fyra perspektiv graderas vid rangordningen i skalan 1-5. Skalan tolkas enligt följande:

• Mycket låg höjd

• Låg höjd

• Viss höjd

• Hög höjd

• Mycket hög höjd

Till ansökan ska bifogas
- godkänt examensarbete på lägst kandidatnivå. Examensarbetet får inte vara äldre än 18 månader räknat från sista ansökningsdag.
- Ladok-utdrag där betyg för avslutade kurser samt på examensarbetet framgår.
Studenten ska även bifoga ett personligt brev på max 2 A4 som motiverar graden av de olika kriterierna samt ge en kort sammanfattning av examensarbetet.

• Motivera grad av nyhetsvärde i examensarbetet.

• Motivera grad av framåtriktning i examensarbetet.

• Motivera grad av genomförande i examensarbetet.

• Motivera grad av ekonomiskt, kulturellt, socialt och kvalitativt värde i examensarbetet.

• Kort sammanfattning av examensarbetet.

Stipendiet utdelas varje år vid ett tillfälle som bestäms efter överenskommelse med Knowit Gävleborg AB.

We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. The Opportunity
Lead the team responsible for the production GCP and Kubernetes infrastructure powering our cloud-native SaaS platform.
The Cloud Infrastructure team owns the cloud environment that powers our products, including GCP architecture, networking, Kubernetes infrastructure, infrastructure provisioning, observability foundations, IAM and secrets, infrastructure security primitives, and cloud cost optimization.
As Senior Manager, Cloud Infrastructure, you will lead experienced infrastructure engineers, set technical strategy and execution priorities, and own the reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency of our underlying cloud environment. You will turn complex infrastructure challenges into clear plans, safe changes, and measurable outcomes.
This is a technical engineering leadership role for someone who has personally built, operated, and troubleshot production cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes clusters, not just deployed applications into existing clusters. You will not implement every Terraform module or resolve every incident yourself, but you must have the depth to guide senior and staff engineers, question designs, and lead decisions during complex infrastructure failures.
Responsibilities

• Hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing team of senior and staff infrastructure engineers; set clear priorities, ownership, expectations, and delivery accountability.

• Own the strategy and evolution of the cloud environment, including GCP architecture, networking, Kubernetes infrastructure, infrastructure provisioning, and shared infrastructure services.

• Provide technical direction for GCP organization and project architecture, shared networking, VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, routing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, load balancing, IAM, and service connectivity.

• Own the technical strategy and operational standards for production Kubernetes/GKE clusters, including provisioning, control-plane and node lifecycle, networking, scheduling, autoscaling, capacity, upgrades, and cluster-level troubleshooting.

• Set engineering standards for Terraform modules, remote state, Git-based reviews, automated validation, infrastructure provisioning, change safety, and reusable infrastructure patterns.

• Establish and evolve infrastructure security foundations including IAM, service accounts, secrets management, network controls, and other cloud security primitives.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your Opportunity

New Relic gives engineering teams real-time insight into their software and infrastructure, so they can find and fix problems fast. The Pipeline Control team builds and runs the product that manages customers’ telemetry pipelines: ingesting, routing, transforming and delivering telemetry at GB/s scale. If those pipelines are slow or down, our customers notice.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own services in production end to end: you’ll build them, deploy them, monitor them and support them. You’ll work with Go, Java, Kafka, Kubernetes and AWS, and grow your skills in large-scale observability systems.

What You’ll Do

• Build and operate big-data-scale pipeline services that ingest, route, transform and deliver telemetry at GB/s throughput.

• Lead design and architecture for new features and scale-ups. Write design docs, weigh trade-offs across throughput, cost and reliability, and drive decisions with partner teams.

• Mentor teammates through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and help raise the team’s engineering standards.

• Own your services in production: observability, on-call, incident response and performance tuning.

• Work with product and other engineering teams to turn customer needs into well-scoped technical work.

This role requires

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building distributed, high-throughput data systems (streaming or batch pipelines).

• Strong production experience in Go and/or Java, and willingness to work in both.

• A solid grounding in distributed systems: partitioning, backpressure, delivery guarantees, failure handling and consistency trade-offs.

• Hands-on experience with Kafka (or an equivalent such as Kinesis or Pulsar), Kubernetes, and a major cloud provider (AWS preferred).

• Experience designing and owning services from design doc through rollout and operation.

• Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions.

• BTech/BE/MTech/ME in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus points if you have

•

• OpenTelemetry experience, especially the Collector (receivers, processors, exporters) and OpAMP.

• Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Parquet and query engines.

• Background in observability (logs, metrics, traces) or building telemetry pipelines.

• Performance profiling and tuning of Go or JVM services (memory, GC, CPU, network).

• Multi-cloud or multi-region experience.

• Experience with GraphQL.

title: ASEAN Partnerships Manager
description:
INTRODUCTION TO THE ROLE

Temporal is a paradigm shift in modern application development, and one of the fastest developer movements in recent memory. Following our $550M Series E at a $12.5B valuation, we’re continuing to power the future of durable applications and have quickly become the orchestrator of choice for production agentic workloads.

As our first partnerships hire in ASEAN, based in Singapore, you’ll build our partner business from zero. There’s no existing partner book to inherit. You’ll identify, recruit and activate the SIs, GSIs and cloud partners who will shape how Temporal goes to market across Southeast Asia, and you’ll turn those relationships into partner-sourced pipeline and closed/won revenue. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our ASEAN field teams to execute with partners, and build a thriving partner ecosystem from the ground up. This role suits a hunter who thrives in white space and measures themselves on the number.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build the ASEAN partner ecosystem from zero: identify, recruit, sign and activate priority SIs, GSIs and cloud partners, and shape the strategy for other partner motions over time

- Originate and close partner-sourced business, and accelerate partner-influenced deals, to help the ASEAN region exceed its number

- Work hand-in-hand with ASEAN sales to make partners a consistent part of account planning, pipeline creation and deal execution

- Co-sell with hyperscaler teams in the region to drive joint pipeline and consumption

- Partner with our Technical Services team to get SI and GSI practitioners trained, certified and delivering successful Temporal projects

- Represent ASEAN at APJ and global levels, working with global partner owners so local execution and global strategy reinforce each other

What You’ll Bring

- 7+ years in partnerships, alliances or enterprise sales in ASEAN, including building a partner ecosystem or territory from scratch

- A track record of originating partner-sourced pipeline and closing deals, with numbers you can point to

- Established relationships with regional and global SIs and hyperscaler partner teams across ASEAN

- Comfort in conversations with developer and architect personas; a background in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, open source or AI is a strong plus

- Experience as an early or first hire in a region, operating without a playbook

- Maniacal attention to detail, excellent work ethic and unwavering commitment to delivering business results

- Demonstrated ability to build rapport with and influence sales, cross-functional teams, partner executives, and global alliance stakeholders

- Highly motivated self-starter - embraces white space, and turns that white space into opportunities and impact

- Willingness to travel regularly across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and the Philippines

title: Senior Accountant
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a detail-oriented, driven Senior Accountant to join our Accounting team at an exciting time of growth for Supabase. As we continue to scale, we're expanding the team to add experience, spread responsibilities, and strengthen the processes that keep our financials accurate and timely. This is a hands-on role with real ownership and a lot of autonomy.

In this role, you'll support the month-end close, perform analytics on financial results, assist with external audit and tax requests, and take on ad-hoc projects. You'll collaborate across Finance and the wider company, including FP&A, People/Payroll, and Legal, and work with our external audit, tax, and technical accounting partners, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes and controls. This role is open to candidates based in North America.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Own key areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close within your assigned areas, preparing workpapers, journal entries, account reconciliations, flux analysis, and accruals in accordance with US GAAP

- Perform detailed analytics over financial results to confirm completeness and accuracy, and investigate and communicate discrepancies promptly

- Partner with FP&A, People/Payroll, Legal, and other teams to understand business processes, ensure proper accounting, and resolve reconciling differences

- Support external audits and tax requests, serving as a point of contact and coordinating with external partners

- Prepare ad-hoc analyses and support reporting requirements

- Take initiative to recommend and implement process improvements that simplify, standardize, and streamline how we work

- Participate in special projects, including process and system improvements

- Handle day-to-day operational accounting activities with a high level of accuracy

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally a mix of public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and private industry

- Have a CPA or equivalent (preferred)

- Have a strong technical accounting background and solid knowledge of US GAAP

- Have ERP experience, and experience in tech or high-growth company accounting is a plus

- Are willing to roll up your sleeves and dig into the details

- Communicate clearly, both in writing and verbally, and are comfortable building relationships at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership and audit partners

- Are self-motivated and proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions

- Are organized and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and can switch gears quickly in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Work well both independently and collaboratively, are comfortable in async teams, and navigate ambiguity with ease

- Are energized by improving processes

We know not everyone will meet every qualification on day one. If you're excited about this role and want to grow with us, we encourage you to apply.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

title: Director, Program Management - Network Economics
description:
Company Description
Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
Zayo seeks a strategic, results-driven director to lead enterprise-wide programs that strengthen the economic performance of its telecommunications network and facility portfolio. Working across Network Strategy, Planning, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Real Estate, Procurement, Product, and Sales, the Director translates complex operational inputs into measurable, executable programs, and projects.

Key Responsibilities
Network Economics & Financial Governance

• Drive cost reduction and asset efficiency across transport, fiber, colocation, facilities, and network infrastructure through migrations, consolidation, service downgrades, decommissioning, capacity rebalancing, relocations, and vendor negotiations.

• Maintain and improve scorecards and executive reporting on savings, utilization, capital efficiency, and return on investment; partner with Leadership and Finance to prep and prioritize investments and capital allocation.

Portfolio & Program Leadership

• Lead a team of Program and Technical Project Managers delivering network growth, capacity planning, lease renewals, acquisitions, relocations, consolidations, site exits, and facility portfolio optimization.

• Lead by example to develop a team that invariably leads steering committees and drives cross-functional decisions. Reinforce accountability, financial discipline, continuous improvement, and data-driven decisions.

• Facilitate governance frameworks, produce executive dashboards, KPIs, operating cadences, risk controls, and reporting.

Processes & Technology

• Zayo in the active process of system, tool, and process transformation as part of the recent Crown Castle (FiberCo) acquisition and AI adoption. In this role, the director will sustain productivity and controls while adapting to change and adoption.

Qualifications
Required

• Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, Economics, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related field (equivalent experience considered).

• Minim

• um of five (5) years in telecommunications, network infrastructure, planning, finance, operations, strategy, or program management; 5+ years leading enterprise-scale portfolios or strategic programs with executive accountability.

• Proven delivery of network optimization, infrastructure investment, capacity planning, operational transformation, or major cost-reduction programs with measurable results.

• Strong financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, business case development, investment analysis, capital planning, and executive presentation skills.

• Knowledge of carrier economics, fiber and transport networks, colocation, and network asset lifecycles; ability to lead technical, operational, financial, and commercial stakeholders.

Preferred

• MBA, PMP, PgMP, or comparable certification; experience with telecom carriers, fiber, broadband, data centers, or infrastructure providers.

• Experience in network grooming, real estate/lease negotiation, facility or POP acquisition, decommissioning, vendor sourcing, and portfolio governance.

• ServiceNow, Aansa, Salesforce, Power BI, Abacus, CoPilot, ChatGPT, Excel financial modeling, and project management tools.

Leadership Competencies
Strategic thinking • Financial and commercial acumen • Portfolio governance • Executive communication • Cross-functional leadership • Data-driven decisions • Risk and stakeholder management • Negotiation • Change leadership • Results orientation

title: Brand Design, Creative Lead
description:
HI, WE'RE CONVEO 👋

Conveo is building the infrastructure for consumer understanding. Global brands like Unilever, Google and Canva use our AI-moderated video conversations to hear from their customers continuously, so their insights, marketing and product teams work from what people actually say, show and feel. We are YC-backed, post-Series A and growing fast.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/4b4eef8f-be2d-4a77-8fbd-51f3d2aa9849/pictures.jpg]

THE ROLE

Conveo's brand is still taking shape, and we want a designer to shape it. You set how Conveo looks and feels, and you make it real yourself: the identity, the decks that win deals, the posts that stop a scroll, the pages on our website, the stand at an industry event.

Our audience is heads of insights and marketing leaders at some of the largest brands in the world. They judge brands for a living, so your work sits next to the best brands they see every day.

Think of a creative director whose main tool is design. When a brief comes in, you push back on it, pick the angle and design the answer. Most of your week is spent designing, and the work you make becomes the direction everyone else follows.

On a given day you might design a new social series, rebuild a pitch deck with an account executive before a big meeting, prototype a launch page with an AI coding tool, lay out a research report, art direct a shoot, and turn a fix you made twice into a template or a small tool so nobody has to make it again.

AI is already part of how you design and build. You have shipped work with it that you are proud of, from imagery and motion to prototypes, and you want room to push it further.

We care more about your work and your drive than your years. If your portfolio is strong and you want to own a brand while it is still early, we want to see it.

You report to Tom Husson, our CMO, and work closely with product marketing, customer marketing, social, events, sales, product design and the founders.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. DESIGN THE WORK THAT MATTERS MOST, YOURSELF

- Founder keynotes, launch visuals, key website pages, research reports and our presence at events.

- Make every piece readable in seconds: clear hierarchy, one focal visual, nothing competing with the point.

- Bring a point of view to every brief. Question the ask when it is wrong, bring the idea you believe in, and take it all the way to finished.

2. SHAPE THE VISUAL IDENTITY, EVERYWHERE IT SHOWS UP

- Evolve how Conveo looks: type, color, layout, grid, imagery, iconography, data visualization and motion.

- Carry it into everything sales puts in front of buyers: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, proposals and leave-behinds. You build these with sales and product marketing, so they hold up in a live meeting and sellers reach for them first.

- Connect brand and product with our product designers, so Conveo feels like one company from the first ad to the app, including how our product screens look in marketing.

- Stretch it to new formats (a booth, a report, a launch film, a social series) so it stays coherent and keeps its character without going stale.

- Turn it into a Figma library and guidelines with real examples, so anyone can see what good looks like.

3. BUILD A DIGITAL IDENTITY THAT STOPS THE SCROLL

- Design how Conveo shows up on screen: social, web, email and paid, in every format each channel needs.

- Give every piece one clear idea a busy buyer gets in under a second, and make it unmistakably Conveo.

- Design in sets of variants, read the results with social and growth (clicks, conversion, how fast the hook lands), and feed what works back into the identity. A test result never justifies an off-brand asset.

4. SET THE CREATIVE DIRECTION THROUGH YOUR WORK

- Design the first version of every launch, campaign and event look, so the direction is something people can see.

- Review design work from across the company, with feedback people can act on n
